# Onyx Elevate

> Free exercise library and premium training programs built by competing athletes — strength, hypertrophy, conditioning, nutrition and recipes.

Onyx Elevate is a fitness platform with a free searchable exercise database (400+ exercises with step-by-step instructions, pro tips and common mistakes), premium training programs and meal plans, a recipe library, and articles written by coaches who actively compete in powerlifting, bodybuilding, strongman, boxing and running.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Onyx Elevate platform.
- [Exercise library](/exercises): Free, searchable database of 400+ exercises filtered by muscle group, equipment, difficulty and type.
- [Training programs](/programs): Premium strength, hypertrophy, conditioning and fat-loss programs.
- [Meal plans](/meal-plans): Premium nutrition plans for cutting, lean muscle and mass gain.
- [Recipes](/recipes): Free high-protein recipe library.
- [Coaches](/coaches): The competing athletes behind every Onyx program.
- [Challenges](/challenges): Free training and habit challenges.
- [The Onyx app](/app): Preview of the upcoming iOS and Android app.
- [Program quiz](/quiz): 7-question quiz that recommends a matching program.
- [Articles](/articles/rpe-explained-simple-guide): Training and nutrition education.
